is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l., An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., and An. arabiensis.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) mutation (Table 6, page 12).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 6 (page 12) provides genotype counts (1014L/1014L, 1014L/1014LF, 1014F/1014LF) for An. coluzzii, An. gambiae, and An. arabiensis.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from the field in Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso (page 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study evaluating the efficacy of VECTRON T500.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the field station in Vallée du Kou, Bama, Burkina Faso (page 4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The experimental hut trial was conducted between August and October 2018 (page 8).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific trial of VECTRON T500.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 6.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of VECTRON T500 (broflanilide) for indoor residual spraying against pyrethroid-resistant malaria vectors in Burkina Faso. It included laboratory cone bioassays and an experimental hut trial. Genotyping for the kdr L1014F mutation was performed on a sub-sample of 602 mosquitoes collected from the huts.
